CREATE TABLE D360.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_BU_20240716
WITH(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
) AS
SELECT *  FROM eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER

UPDATE DAH
SET
YTD_BANK_ID =   YTD.BANK_ID
,YTD_ACID    =   YTD.ACID
,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL    =   YTD.PREVIOUS_CURRBAL
,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL   =   YTD.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL
,CURRENT_EOD_DATE    =   YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE
,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL =   YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
,ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL    =   YTD.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL
,YTD_BNK_CODE    =   YTD.BNK_CODE
,YTD_SOURCE_CODE =   YTD.SOURCE_CODE
,YTD_FILE_NAME   =   YTD.FILE_NAME
,YTD_INSERT_DTTM =   YTD.INSERT_DTTM
,YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE = YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/DT.DAYOFYEAR
,YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP = YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL/DT.DAYOFYEAR
---Need to be derived: DAH.YTD_BUSINESS_DATE    =   YTD.BUSINESS_DATE
FROM eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER DAH
    INNER JOIN
            (SELECT *
            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CURRENT_EOD_DATE, ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY ACID) RN
            FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
            WHERE CURRENT_EOD_DATE IN ('2024-01-31', '2024-02-29')
            ) YTD
        ON DAH.AAS_ACID = YTD.ACID
        AND DAH.AAS_BANK_ID = YTD.BANK_ID
        AND DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE = YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE
        AND YTD.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN eds.DATE_DIM DT
        ON DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE = DT.FULLDATE
    WHERE DAH.AAS_AS_OF_DATE IN ('2024-01-31', '2024-02-29')
AND DAH.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP'

SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'D360' TBLS FROM D360.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER_BU_20240716 
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(1) CNT, 'EDS' TBLS FROM eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
